descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S12 Step 5: a status changed by hand before the roll is not affected by it

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 A status already changed by hand before the day rolls is not affected by the roll (step 5) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)
  • U5 New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day without the physician touching them; a status set today stays today (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Day 1: patient A set New Admission then changed by hand to Follow-up; patient B set New Admission then changed by hand to Consult at 23:00; day 2: patient C set New Admission at 08:00

When Let the day roll to day 2 (and C to day 3) without touching them

Then A stays Follow-up; B is decided by Q2 (restart-the-clock reading: Follow-up on day 2; exempt reading: Consult); C stays New Admission all of day 2 and reads Follow-up on day 3. Same in Nursing Home

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'A status already changed by hand is not affected by the day roll' + AC 4. Only cells A and C are judged until Q2 is answered

Where it ran: dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) (TIME (hand change in the UI, then shift encTypeDay back through rounding:update/snf:update and run applyLifecycle; aging.ts pattern)) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
